zh: 这次把编辑器里的编号格式真正接回了 Word：更新当前公式后，后续新增编号会沿用；修复新文档第一次插入后格式回退、连续插入光标停在原处的问题。选中靠后的公式会自动滚动到可见位置，保存后系统重开会重新读取列表。也补了关闭最后一份文档的状态清理。已在 Word 16.114.1 检查连续插入、样式、左右编号、删除后重编号、引用、多文档和 120 条公式文档的保存重开；私人测试材料不随包发布。
en: Number formats in the editor now write back to Word and become the default for later numbered insertions. This fixes the format reverting after the first insertion in a new document and advances the original insertion cursor. Later equations scroll into view, reopening after a save refreshes the list, and closing the last document clears stale state. Word 16.114.1 checks cover repeated insertion, styles, left/right numbering, renumbering after deletion, references, multiple documents, and saving and reopening a 120-equation document. Private test materials are not distributed.
